speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Altitude twelve hundred meters. Wind shear forty-five knots. Commercial transit is grounded. Stratos Docks is under lockdown.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Altitude twelve hundred meters. Wind shear forty-five knots. Commercial transit is grounded. Stratos Docks is under lockdown.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Three gunships on the upper pads. But Bay Four has a heavy transport fueled and idling. That is our ride.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Three gunships on the upper pads. But Bay Four has a heavy transport fueled and idling. That is our ride.

speaker: TITAN
text: Magnetic mooring clamps. Reinforced locks. Get me to the release valves, and I will free that bird.
subtitle: TITAN: Magnetic mooring clamps. Reinforced locks. Get me to the release valves, and I will free that bird.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Those fuel lines carry liquid hydrogen. One spark could take the deck with it. We keep this clean.
subtitle: OCEANUS: Those fuel lines carry liquid hydrogen. One spark could take the deck with it. We keep this clean.

speaker: AURA
text: Air traffic control is calling in interceptors. The flight grid is trying to pin us on the catwalks.
subtitle: AURA: Air traffic control is calling in interceptors. The flight grid is trying to pin us on the catwalks.

speaker: SURYA
text: I can cover the flak crossing with my solar barrier. Stay close until we are off the flight line.
subtitle: SURYA: I can cover the flak crossing with my solar barrier. Stay close until we are off the flight line.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Dual-phase lasers across the maintenance route. I will cross first and open a path through the security grid.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Dual-phase lasers across the maintenance route. I will cross first and open a path through the security grid.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Flight path ready. Once we have the transport, we climb toward the Spire upper command ring.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Flight path ready. Once we have the transport, we climb toward the Spire upper command ring.

speaker: KAITO
text: Weapons live. Breach the flight deck, seize that gunship, and take this fight upstairs. Axiom Force, move out.
subtitle: KAITO: Weapons live. Breach the flight deck, seize that gunship, and take this fight upstairs. Axiom Force, move out.
